# MCP Surface

> Offline CLI and ESM library (`@hexmillionaire/mcp-surface`, Node 24.8+, zero runtime dependencies) that lints a saved MCP `tools/list` JSON artifact and checks two saved artifacts for breaking schema changes. Inputs are compatible when every old accepted input fits the new schema; outputs are compatible when every new possible output fits the old schema. It never starts servers, calls tools, or fetches `$ref`s.

Quick use:

- `npx -y @hexmillionaire/mcp-surface@0.1.1 compare baseline.json current.json` prints a JSON report.
- `mcp-surface lint FILE`, `mcp-surface normalize FILE > baseline.json`, `--format markdown`, `--fail-on breaking,unknown,review|never`.
- Exit codes: 0 policy passed; 1 findings failed the policy (default fails on `breaking` and `unknown`); 2 invalid usage, invalid artifact or file error.
- Input file: `{"tools":[...]}` or a JSON-RPC result envelope `{"result":{"tools":[...]}}`, all pages merged, no `nextCursor`.
- Finding levels: `breaking` (validated counterexample or removed tool), `unknown` (unsupported keyword such as `$ref`, `anyOf`, `pattern`, `format`, or proof not found), `review` (metadata/annotations changed or missing), `compatible`.
- Open objects matter: without `additionalProperties: false`, adding a typed optional input property is breaking, because the old schema accepted any value under that name.
